# Template provenance

- Repository: https://github.com/StartBootstrap/startbootstrap-small-business
- Inspected commit: 9c5ef57a25c2c8e1223b274ef7312375925e281c
- Reference: https://startbootstrap.github.io/startbootstrap-small-business/
- License: MIT; exact license text retained in LICENSE.
- Reviewed on: 20 October 2026, Australia/Sydney.

The owner approved its simple image-and-introduction layout, enquiry band and three-column card composition. These visual structures are adapted into the existing bilingual TanStack Start application. Bootstrap CSS/JavaScript, sample marketing text and demo images are not dependencies of this site. Existing service content, actual images, business identity and route ownership remain site-specific.

`reference.html` is the upstream reference source for inspection, not a public site route or runnable product entry point.
